title: [CQ-R13c2] Wrapper fail-closed protected runtime paths
description:
Objective: when the JetBrains launcher marks a session protected (MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1, from CQ-R13c1), both agent wrappers use exactly MOE_PROXY_PATH and MOE_DAEMON_PATH or refuse to start. They never fall back to their own root's packages or to the global install. Without the marker, the wrappers keep today's fallback exactly, preserving legacy policy. This is CQ-R01's follow-up 6.

Split out of CQ-R13 (task-f4811a72) by architect-e4b7eee0 on 2026-10-30. It depends on CQ-V08b (task-7f82e200), which also edits moe-agent.sh, moe-agent.ps1 and the postflight harness, so these edits land after it. It is file-disjoint from CQ-R13c1, and the env contract is pinned in both rows.

Today:
- moe-agent.sh uses PROXY_PATH_OVERRIDE and DAEMON_PATH_OVERRIDE only when the file exists (`-f`). Otherwise it falls back to its own root, then the global install (~line 716 and ~1563).
- moe-agent.ps1 uses $env:MOE_PROXY_PATH (~459) and $env:MOE_DAEMON_PATH (~599), then $PSScriptRoot\.., then Get-MoeInstallPath.

Deliverable:
- With MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED exactly '1', each wrapper requires both variables to be non-empty, absolute paths to regular files. Otherwise it exits non-zero before writing any MCP config or starting any daemon or CLI.
- The refusal uses one fixed code in both launchers, MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED_PATH_MISSING, plus a one-line message that names the failing variable, never the path.
- Any other value of MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED counts as unset (legacy), and legacy behavior stays byte-identical.
- Tests in scripts/tests/postflight.sh and scripts/tests/postflight.ps1, daemon-free like the harness's other wrapper rows:
  - protected with a missing proxy path, and protected with a missing daemon path, are both refused with the code, with no fallback taken;
  - protected with both files present proceeds;
  - unset keeps today's fallback.
- scripts/tests/parity-check.sh still passes, with the new code and variable name in both launchers.

Out of scope:
- the JetBrains marker (CQ-R13c1);
- the other R01 follow-ups;
- VS Code;
- .moe edits.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): bash scripts/tests/postflight.sh && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh. Also run the PowerShell harness, scripts/tests/postflight.ps1, through powershell.exe, or record that it is unavailable.
definitionOfDone: With MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1, moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 start only with absolute, existing MOE_PROXY_PATH and MOE_DAEMON_PATH files. Otherwise each exits with MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED_PATH_MISSING before any MCP config, daemon or CLI start, and never uses its own root or the global install. Shown by harness tests.
Without the marker, or with any other value, both wrappers keep today's fallback order unchanged. Shown by harness tests.
parity-check.sh passes with the new code and variable present in both launchers.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
